g1.label: 1. If you play for too many hours, your eyes ___
g1.why: Zero conditional: if + present simple, present simple, for something always true.

g2.label: 2. If she practises every day, she ___
g2.why: First conditional: if + present simple, will + infinitive, for a likely future result.

g3.label: 3. If I ___
g3.why: Second conditional: if + past simple for an imaginary present situation.

g4.label: 4. If he had not spent so long gaming, his grades ___
g4.why: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle, for an unreal past.

g5.label: 5. If a player breaks the guidelines, the platform ___
g5.why: Zero conditional: both halves in the present simple for a standing rule.

g6.label: 6. If developers add more diverse characters, players ___
g6.why: First conditional: a real future possibility takes will + infinitive.

g7.label: 7. If esports ___
g7.why: Second conditional uses 'were' for all persons in an unreal situation.

g8.label: 8. If parents had set limits, teenagers today ___
g8.why: Mixed conditional: a past condition with a present result takes would + infinitive.

g1.label: 1. competitive gaming at professional level
g1.why: Esports is professional competitive gaming played before large audiences.

g2.label: 2. hours spent looking at a screen
g2.why: Screen time is the daily total spent looking at screens.

g3.label: 3. designed to keep players hooked
g3.why: Something that keeps you coming back compulsively is addictive.

g4.label: 4. makes players feel inside the world
g4.why: An immersive game surrounds the player and feels real.

g5.label: 5. several players online at the same time
g5.why: Multiplayer games let several people play together at once.

g6.label: 6. the key to healthy gaming habits
g6.why: Moderation means keeping the amount reasonable rather than stopping.

g7.label: 7. rules deciding what to recommend
g7.why: An algorithm decides which content a platform shows you.

g8.label: 8. broadcasting gameplay live
g8.why: A livestream broadcasts in real time over the internet.
